expenditures.detail: TRACED, LOCALISED, AND NOTHING NUDGED. The 30 Schedule B rows sum to 7,914.14, which is +0.50 over Box D. The PER-SHEET gate (§L2 - and both sheets do print their own subtotal, so each is a closable unit) localises it precisely: SHEET p8's 15 rows sum to 117.87 + 10.30 + 92.31 + 5.00 + 415.51 + 4.00 + 115.28 + 113.40 + 12.33 + 39.70 + 61.98 + 500.00 + 300.00 + 300.00 + 500.00 = 2,587.68, EXACTLY its printed subtotal; SHEET p7's 15 rows sum to 49.19 + 767.11 + 20.33 + 500.00 + 70.00 + 925.00 + 1246.22 + 117.87 + 750.61 + 47.92 + 152.81 + 225.00 + 70.00 + 84.40 + 300.00 = 5,326.46 against its own printed subtotal of 5,325.96. So the entire delta is +0.50 on ONE sheet, p7, and the whole of it is the filer's arithmetic: his two printed page subtotals add to his printed grand total and to Box D to the cent, so the figure he under-added is the p7 page subtotal itself. WHAT WAS RULED OUT BEFORE CALLING IT FILER ARITHMETIC: (a) MISREAD CELL - ALL FIFTEEN p7 amount cells were escalated to 1200 dpi and every one reproduced exactly as recorded; the only cell whose cents were even arguable, row 12's 225.00, was re-escalated to 1600 dpi and its raised 'co' cents match the same filer's 500.co / 925.co / 70.00 elsewhere on the sheet, so no single cell can absorb 0.50 and the attribution is NOT unique (the §C5 outcome: 'more than one cell could have explained it, so I changed none'). (b) §H3 DOUBLED BAND and (c) §F1 trap-5 A ROW BELOW THE LAST RULE - both EXCLUDED BY DIRECTION as well as by crop: a missed row makes a sum fall SHORT, and this sum runs OVER; the row-15 crop rendered the last entry and the strip below it rendered the printed subtotal label. (d) §H4 an in-grid subtotal - excluded, rows 1-14 total 5,026.46, not 300.00. (e) CORRELATED-ERROR SCREEN - run INSIDE the document, which is the only place it can honestly be run here: the same filer's OTHER report in this same bundle closes EXACTLY on its expenditure side (after his own correction), so the +0.50 is a one-off slip and not a repeating habit; his 2026 filing exists in index.csv but was NOT opened, because differencing across filings is forbidden. The printed subtotal is retained verbatim at 5,325.96, all 30 rows publish verbatim, and every p7 row carries needs_review=1 since the delta cannot be pinned to one of them.
